owner_intent.purpose: Converge as quickly and simply as possible on direct reproducible vector-based model control through the Global J-Space path. The trigger is goal-bound, not provider-bound: every removable blocker must be eliminated or routed around automatically until only scientifically meaningful negatives or genuinely unavailable external capabilities remain.

success_semantics.core_mechanism: actual runtime consumption of a bound model-specific vector intervention
success_semantics.api_boundary: The successful runtime must be callable through an exact API boundary. A loopback-only local API is valid and preferred when it removes hosted-provider blockers.

convergence_ladder.reason: Shortest already-implemented zero-provider-billing path to a runtime-observed hidden-state vector intervention with an exact loopback API boundary; removes provider billing, credential entitlement, route fallback, provider-runtime identity, rate-limit and hosted-parameter blockers without requiring native-cvec integration first.
convergence_ladder.target: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B exact revision on a loopback-only API with runtime-observed activation-vector consumption

convergence_ladder.reason: Native-cvec replication/strengthening path after first causal completion, or fallback if the PyTorch hook path is technically unavailable.
convergence_ladder.target: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF on loopback llama-server with native control-vector controls

convergence_ladder.reason: Cheap independent component discriminator only. It may accelerate understanding but must never block completion of the local hidden-state path.
Optional replication path; absence is not a Trigger-1 blocker.

classes.REPAIR_NOW: Implement/test the smallest local repair in the same trigger run.
classes.ROUTE_AROUND: Switch to the next convergence-ladder path without waiting.
classes.EXTERNAL_TRANSIENT: Continue the independent local path; external recovery may run in parallel but cannot gate completion.
classes.SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE: Preserve as evidence and change hypothesis/vector/layer/gain while keeping the success law unchanged.
classes.HARD_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY: Fail closed only for the prohibited action; continue all remaining authorized local work.

parallelism.rule: When one slot is blocked, it is immediately reassigned to the highest-information unblocked dependency on the primary path. Exactly ten fixed hypotheses are no longer an owner requirement.

evidence_boundary: Scientific rigor is not weakened by this directive. The optimization changes the route to the evidence, not the evidence threshold: no positive Trigger-1 completion without actual vector consumption, exact identities, six matched controls, disjoint holdout, fixed seeds and reproducible directional effect.
